author: bplc
description: 拓扑图形插件:消费解析器拓扑事件,与原版TOPO对齐(NID选择/映射表/帧记录/悬浮成功率)。
description_en: Topology graphics plugin: consumes parser topo events, aligned with the native TOPO page (NID selector, mapping table, frame records, hover success rates).
name: js-topo

settings.title: 最大节点数
settings.description: 拓扑图最多绘制的节点数,超出时只显示前 N 个
settings.description_en: Max nodes drawn on the topology graph; only the first N are shown when exceeded

settings.title: 显示节点标签
settings.description: 是否在节点旁显示 TEI/MAC 标签
settings.description_en: Whether to show TEI/MAC labels next to nodes

settings.title: 布局方式
settings.description_en: Node layout algorithm for the topology graph
